name: CSS - Box Model & Spacing
description: Learn about margins, padding, and borders

rules.text: Create a div element with some content
rules.hint: Add a div to your HTML: <div>This is my box</div>. We'll style this div to learn about the box model.

rules.text: Add a border to your div using CSS
rules.hint: Style your div: div { border: 2px solid black; }. The border property takes width, style, and color.

rules.text: Add margin to create space around the element
rules.hint: Add margin: div { border: 2px solid black; margin: 20px; }. Margin pushes other elements away.

rules.text: Set a specific width for the element
rules.hint: Complete your styling: div { border: 2px solid black; margin: 20px; width: 300px; }. Width controls element size.

completion.message: 🎉 Amazing! You understand the CSS box model!
